preserved_details: When bAllowWindImpulses is false, all cached responders are visited, using global vector; UID snapshot construction still happens, but lifecycle updates do not.

Radius sampling uses CurrentRadius and CurrentMagnitude, spherical distance and linearly decaying radial direction. Cylinder sampling ignores changing entries and zero magnitude, uses XY distance, explicit direction unless exactly zero, inner plateau and linear outer falloff.

Delta sampling uses only first delta, requires successful snapshot lookup and WindImpulseBounds containment, chooses Previous/Current/Desired magnitude by inner/band/outer radius and bRippleOutward, with snapshot cylinder falloff.
Only speed changes trigger material setup and writes. Direction-only changes do not. Wind-vector material write is skipped when speed becomes exactly0. Its alpha is responder bounds midpoint Z.
Curve channels0..3 select WindSpeedCurve RGBA,4..7 WindPannerSpeedCurve RGBA; unknown channels produce0. Paired panner speed/offset equations retain world-time continuity.

Invalid responder removal fixes only first matching moved-last index in each cache. Source checks cursor against responder count, then indexes responder using cached value; draft preserves this unusual guard.
Radius blends smoothstep over remaining time, swap-removes settled zero desired/current magnitude only inside changed-state branch. Source does not recompute bounds in completion branches.

Completed first delta is swap-removed; matching cylinder gets final magnitude and changing state based on first remaining matching delta index. Changed event precedes setting pending. Zero idle cylinder removal precedes starting next delta, with final reverse cleanup thereafter.

Paired parameter writes directly index PairedVariablesData by ID.PairIndex with range guard. Despite apparent sparse-ID inconsistency, original sampling uses direct indexing and must not be replaced with a search. This is resolved original behavior, not a closure blocker.

delta_sampling_assembly.section_selection: 0x141de032a..0x141de035b computes sqrt((Y-centerY)^2 + (X-centerX)^2), then COMISS distance, inner / JAE: unordered falls through to inner. 0x141de065e..0x141de0668 COMISS distance, outer / JBE: unordered takes band. Therefore inner if !(distance >= inner); otherwise band if !(distance > outer); otherwise outer. Equal inner selects band (unless outer smaller); equal outer selects band. Reversed radii have no band for ordered distance >= inner. No section-width division occurs in this selection.
delta_sampling_assembly.live_magnitudes: Delta +0x2c PreviousMagnitude, +0x30 SectionCurrentMagnitude, +0x34 DesiredMagnitude. 0x141de04bc and 0x141de0640 select Desired and Previous respectively for inner outward/inward; 0x141de0a9c selects SectionCurrent for band; 0x141de07cd and 0x141de093e select Previous and Desired respectively for outer outward/inward. These load/multiply live direction registers immediately before accumulation; no uninitialized decompiler scalar needs inference.
delta_sampling_assembly.bounds_comparisons: 0x141de02e1..0x141de0324 tests each coordinate against min using COMISS/JB (unordered rejects) and max using COMISS/JA (unordered passes); bounds validity byte is not consulted. Updated draft preserves this comparison topology.
